interactiveModels.dataType: Newly authored deterministic hypothetical returns; not market data or thesis replication
interactiveModels.cppi: Monthly rebalance, no leverage or shorts, fractional holdings, terminal floor target
benchmarks: Constant Mix 60% risky / 40% safe with monthly rebalancing
interactiveModels.costs: No transaction costs, bid-ask spread, slippage, taxes or dividends
interactiveModels.protectivePut: One asset and one European put, held to expiry; hypothetical premium; no option pricing model
interactiveModels.limitations: No probability or forecasting claim; monthly observations omit intramonth losses; model does not include market impact, liquidity constraints or counterparty failure
